fields.statement: Verified commit 21f24b894 in a detached worktree. go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestCheckHeadBuild|TestLandRenderHeadBuild|TestShipHeadBuildOnDemand|TestShipPrePushCheck': exit 0. TestCheckHeadBuild covers each acceptance point: a named head runs as check --json with --base, --skip-reference and --branch-newer-format passed through; an ok report, and a fail report with exit status 1, are reported with check's usual exit; unset or self-named head runs in-process with no exec; a missing head with SHIP_HEAD_BUILD set is built first; a missing head with no build command, or output that is no report, errors and names the head build; a running binary that is not the PATH rhiza runs in-process with no build; runCheck called directly runs in-process. go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/api (full package, 750 tests): exit 0 in 416s under machine load; two earlier runs hit the 240s cap with no failures, TestReadBudget alone taking 105s. go test -p 2 -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(ship-land-branch-build|run-ship-land-conflict|docs-reference-stale|ship-local-gate|ship-gate-head-check)$': exit 0; the new ship-gate-head-check script shows plain rhiza check failing on an edited docs/reference/cli.md, the head-gate run passing with head.log holding check --json, and the plain-gate run failing on command 1 rhiza check. make self-check: exit 0. SHIP_HEAD_RHIZA=$TMPDIR/no-head-rhiza SHIP_HEAD_BUILD= make self-check: exit 0, no head built. rhiza ship generate and rhiza render: exit 0, no changes. Diff read against the Decisions gate-check-via-head and gate-check-head-fallback: the check op's entry (runCheckOp) redirects only outside dry-run; the in-process runCheck callers are unchanged; the child runs with headChildEnv. ship-rhiza.toml's comment now names check. Beyond the listed files: ship_prepush.go passes headChildEnv to the pre-push head check (a recursion guard), and ship_build.go adds nil ctx.Git guards; both are small and in scope. No stubs or TODOs.
